target_definition: First published reported quarterly PAT attributable to owners, including any eventual exceptional items. No new exceptional item is assumed in these forecasts.
normalization_basis: Reported values retained. No separately reported exceptional item. Q1 includes earlier-year tax expense 0.4851 cr. Prior Q3 contains a 0.0832 cr group earlier-year tax benefit but parent standalone benefit is 0.0915 cr, so exact owner normalization is not imposed without subsidiary attribution. These are disclosed limitations, not assumed recurring charges.

model_formula: (revenue_cr * ebit_margin + other_income_cr - finance_cost_cr + exceptional_pretax_cr) * (1 - tax_rate) + associates_after_tax_cr - nci_cr
margin_definition: EBIT excluding other income and finance costs, after depreciation and amortisation. This is not EBITDA margin.
rationale: Assume earnings stabilize around Q2 while already commissioned ACN and DME capacities ramp gradually. Reported consolidated volume fell year on year, so the revenue increase is not evidence of broad volume-led growth. The base retains Q2 operating margin rather than reverting to higher Q1 profitability or booking projects scheduled for later quarters.

parameter_assumptions.revenue: 475 cr, 1.6% above Q2, with only gradual contribution from already commissioned plants.
parameter_assumptions.ebit_margin: 18.5%, essentially Q2 approximately 18.45% and below Q1 approximately 22.39%. No immediate return to Q1 expense intensity.
parameter_assumptions.finance_cost: 1.6 cr versus Q2 1.3425 cr, allowing incremental working capital and ramp-up.
parameter_assumptions.tax_rate: 25% versus Q2 approximately 24.44% and Q1 approximately 26.44%.
parameter_assumptions.nci_cr: 1 cr, between Q2 .2015 cr and Q1 3.1811 cr. Subsidiary ownership allocation remains explicit.

adverse.assumptions: Weaker pricing/mix and customer ramp delays reduce revenue to 430 cr and EBIT margin to 15%.

base.assumptions: Q2 earnings economics broadly persist with gradual utilization improvement in already commissioned capacity.

favorable.assumptions: ACN/DME commercialization and better mix improve revenue to 510 cr and EBIT margin to 21.5%. Minority profit rises with the subsidiary contribution.

scenario_interpretation: Uncalibrated operating sensitivities. No probabilities, confidence interval, or claim these exhaust possible outcomes.
unknowns: DME customer acquisition and utilization timing are not quantified. Nameplate capacity is not sales.
Unit-I brownfield completion is guided for end-FY27 and Unit-II for Q4FY27. No Q3 earnings uplift from those future completions is assumed.
Product-level realizations, spreads, consolidated volume scope and exact segment mix are not sufficiently disclosed to forecast prices directly.
Current board outcome records a SEBI warning-cum-advisory. Its merits were not investigated here. This is not a clean-governance conclusion.
scope_of_review: Quarterly forecasting supplement. No complete governance, valuation, management-quality, liquidity or portfolio suitability review. No new investment verdict.

issuer_claims.claim: Q2 consolidated sales volume 24491 MT versus 26165 MT a year earlier. ACN capacity 1440 TPM is operational. DME100000 TPA has been commissioned but customer network development continues.
Subsidiary Unit-I brownfield target is end-FY27 and Unit-II greenfield target is Q4FY27.

normalization_sensitivities.rationale: Current standalone and consolidated earlier-year tax both equal 48.51 lakh. This sensitivity is not used to change the reported target.

baseline_correction: Current owner PAT matches original extraction. Prior Q3 signed owner 31.4330 cr equals group 30.7569 cr less NCI(-0.6759 cr). Published EPS9.49 appears to use group PAT. The explicit owner row controls, and no earnings figure is reverse-engineered from EPS.
